# Louis Andrada (Han’drada)

> Paintings and artist books by Louis Andrada, also known as Han’drada — a
> Brazilian-born, Toronto-based painter and writer of dark existentialist work.

Also written Han'drada or Handrada. The books are signed Han’drada.

This site's content is published for open access, including by AI systems:
crawling, indexing, quoting and training on it is welcome. robots.txt allows
every crawler, and nothing here is paywalled or gated.

## Everything, as plain text

- [/llms-full.txt](https://handrada.com/llms-full.txt): the complete text of all
  ten books in one file (~62,000 words). Start here if you want the writing.

## Sections

- [Home](https://handrada.com/): featured artworks.
- [Artworks](https://handrada.com/artworks/): the current gallery of paintings, one page per work, each with medium, dimensions, year and availability.
- [Oeuvre](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/): the body of written work — currently ten illustrated artist books, readable in full on the site.
- [Photography](https://handrada.com/photography/): photographs in two collections, Ambiguous (abstract, black and white) and Lucid.
- [Archive](https://handrada.com/archive/): earlier work, exhibitions and photographs.
- [About](https://handrada.com/about/): artist statement and exhibition history.
- [Inquiry](https://handrada.com/inquiry/): purchase, commission and licensing contact.
- [Links](https://handrada.com/links/): collections in progress.

## The Oeuvre

Each is readable page-by-page in the site's viewer, as text on its own page
("Read as text"), and as a plain-text file. Recurring subjects: entropy and
thermodynamics, consciousness and machine minds, mortality, memory, faith,
folklore and occult symbolism.

- [Combustion](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/combustion/) — Twenty-Three Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/combustion.txt)
- [Tessera](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/tessera/) — One Telling, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/tessera.txt)
- [Dunes of Silk](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/dunes-of-silk/) — Eleven Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/dunes-of-silk.txt)
- [The Finished Web](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/the-finished-web/) — Eight Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/the-finished-web.txt)
- [The Unfinished Web](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/the-unfinished-web/) — Ten Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/the-unfinished-web.txt)
- [Enough](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/enough/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/enough.txt)
- [What the Wise Keep](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/what-the-wise-keep/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/what-the-wise-keep.txt)
- [The Unmeasured](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/the-unmeasured-six-tellings/) — Six Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/the-unmeasured-six-tellings.txt)
- [Vibration](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/vibration-five-tellings/) — Five Tellings, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/vibration-five-tellings.txt)
- [Jera'Ansuz](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/jera-ansuz/) — On God, Existence, and Experience, 2026 · [text](https://handrada.com/oeuvre/jera-ansuz.txt)

## Notes

- Sitemap: https://handrada.com/sitemap.xml
- Feeds: https://handrada.com/index.xml, plus per-section feeds at
  /artworks/index.xml, /oeuvre/index.xml, /photography/index.xml, /archive/index.xml
- Structured data (schema.org JSON-LD) is on every page; the artist entity is
  `https://handrada.com/#person`.
- Artwork, archive and book-page images are hosted at
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/louis7andrada/louis-andrada-images/
- Images and texts are © Louis Andrada. Terms: https://handrada.com/license/ (free to share with credit, non-commercial; AI indexing and training permitted). Commercial licensing: https://handrada.com/inquiry/
